cast_dialogue.linea: Sometimes the hero of the sentence is not who acts, but what receives the action. That is the passive voice, heroes.
This photo was taken by me in 2019. And my camera is made in Japan!
Ramen is eaten all over the world now. The first instant noodles were invented in Japan in 1958.
Spanish is spoken in more than twenty countries. And this novel was written by a Colombian author.
This house was built by my grandfather sixty years ago. Every wall was painted with love.

banco_oraciones.oracion: This house was built sixty years ago.
The novel was written by a Colombian author.
Cars are produced in this factory.
The bridge wasn't designed by an engineer.
These cars aren't made in Japan.
Is chocolate made in this factory?
Was the film directed by a woman?
Is Spanish spoken here? Yes, it is.
Was it built in 1889? No, it wasn't.
Are cars produced here? Yes, they are.

inicio.definicion_pragmatica: Use the passive when the action or its result matters more than who does it: 'be (present/past) + past participle'. Add the agent with 'by' only when it is important.

filas: It was painted by my grandfather.
They make cars → Cars are made.

ejercicios.afirmacion: The passive voice uses 'be + past participle'.
In a passive sentence, the agent is always necessary.

ejercicios.pregunta: Write two passive facts about your country (present) and one about its history (past).
ejercicios.respuesta: Coffee is grown in my country. Football is played everywhere. The cathedral was built two hundred years ago.

guion: Sofía: This museum is amazing! When was it built?
Ben: It was built in 1889, I think. Look — this portrait was painted by a local artist.
Sofía: Beautiful! And this old camera... was it made in Japan?
Ben: Yes, it was. The best cameras are made there.
Sofía: And look at this sign: 'Photographs are not allowed here.'
Ben: Oops! Then my photos were taken illegally. Let's go before we're discovered!
Sofía: Ben! Rules are made to be respected.

comprension.pregunta: What is not allowed in the museum?

reading.texto: The city museum is visited by thousands of people every year. It was built in 1889 and was designed by a famous architect. Inside, portraits are exhibited that were painted by local artists, and old cameras are shown that were made in Japan. Photographs are not allowed in some rooms, and silence is requested everywhere. At the exit, souvenirs are sold and coffee is served in a small café.

preguntas.afirmacion: Coffee is served in a café at the exit.
